title: The free online course that got me a 6 figure job

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You know that free course I took? It landed me a six-figure job in three months.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: With AI skills in demand, this is your moment to level up fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a free online course called "AI for Everyone" by Stanford’s Andrew Ng.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It teaches you how to build AI tools without needing a coding background.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Tech companies are hiring non-coders who can use AI to solve real problems.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? You don’t need a degree to land a high-paying AI job.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how to get started? Let me show you in the next video.
